ModMetaData.name: AutoRim - MCP Bridge
ModMetaData.author: AutoRim
ModMetaData.description:
Exposes the colony to an external MCP server over a loopback-only bridge, so an AI assistant can read colony state and issue orders in natural language.
The bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 only and requires a token that is generated on first run. Destructive actions require explicit confirmation. The bridge can be disabled at any time from this mod's settings.
No Harmony patching is performed.
